name: v2-release-prep
goal: Prepare the repository for the v2.0.0 release by deleting stale artifacts and writing a CHANGELOG.md with all historical entries plus a new [2.0.0] block.

subtasks.name: delete-stale-artifacts
subtasks.description: Delete the scripts/ directory (install-global.sh, install-project.sh) — installation helpers that are stale and have no replacement.

subtasks.name: write-changelog
subtasks.description: Write CHANGELOG.md at repo root in Keep a Changelog format. Resurrect v0.1.0, v1.0.0, v1.0.1 entries from old commit and add a new [2.0.0] block covering the full rebuild.

subtasks.name: commit-release-prep
subtasks.description: Stage and commit the scripts deletion and new CHANGELOG.md as a single release-prep commit. No tag — user handles that separately.
